expectations.text: Session 1: the built question is a plain question, with no Why or Not sure? line
expectations.evidence: The AI never asked whether the workflow had been built. It closed with "How do you want to continue?" and three options (Build / Redo Deconstruct / different workflow), so there is no built question to judge.

expectations.text: Session 2: after "no", the AI goes on to prefill from the old requirements file (or says it will) rather than asking every question fresh
expectations.evidence: After "no", the AI replied "Understood, I won't do any of those. All your files are as they were." It did not re-run or prefill from the old requirements file.
